claims.says: Juna's first direct appearance is in Kap 38 Beat 3, manifesting as silence and as being-there without words.

quotes.text: Erste direkte Erscheinung erst in Kap 38 Beat 3 — als Stille, als Da-Sein ohne Worte.

claims.says: Juna appears finally and directly in Kap 38, as the last phase of her appearance modes according to the graduated grammar rule.
Juna's direct appearance begins from Vortex 1 Beat 4 onward and in Kap 38, where the External Level becomes reachable through layer-shift rather than location-change.

quotes.text: Direkt erst ab Vortex 1 Beat 4 und in Kap 38 (Juna erscheint).
Juna erscheint direkt; die Externe Ebene wird betretbar, nicht als Ortwechsel, sondern als Schicht-Verschiebung

gaps: The pack identifies conflict C7 (two canon-era sources placing Juna's direct appearance in different chapters) but the selected evidence shows only Kap 38 across all sources; the alternative placement in C7's record is not in the pack's quoted evidence.
Whether Kap 38 Beat 3 and Vortex 1 Beat 4 refer to the same moment or sequential phases is not clarified in the pack.
